POS 'Cetak Struk PDF' from invoice panel verified. Payroll flow: created TEST_Karyawan (kasir), marked today's attendance via /nav-kehadiran, visited Komisi (loads with active rate 0%), opened Rekap Gaji → TEST_Karyawan auto-listed, archived Oktober 2026 (toast: 'Slip gaji Oktober 2026 diarsipkan (2 karyawan)'), opened the archive card, printed slip for TEST_Karyawan both before archive and from archived state (Slip_Gaji_TEST_Karyawan_Oktober_2026.pdf). All 23 export/print events triggered successful browser downloads with correct extensions. minor.issue: Route not implemented in server.py (grep: only POST /payroll/archive and GET /payroll/archives exist). Current UI does not expose a delete button so no user-visible bug, but any admin trying to prune old archives has no API path. Returns 404 when called directly.

ui_bugs.issue: Hydration warning: '<span> cannot be a child of <option>' coming from mark-employee-select. Dev-only VE wrapper injects span inside <option> because the option children mix JSX expressions and literal text: `{u.name} ({u.role})`. Same class of issue previously fixed in StokOpname.jsx:55 by using a single template literal.

integration_issues.issue: First click on export-excel-button on freshly loaded Riwayat page timed out waiting for download event (12s). Clicking the same button a second time (after small delay) succeeded immediately and produced Riwayat_Transaksi.xlsx. All subsequent/other-page Excel exports worked first-try. Likely a race between page data load and XLSX.writeFile when table rows are still mounting. Not blocking (user retry works) but worth guarding by disabling the button until data is ready.

action_items: Fix Kehadiran.jsx:141 — change `<option ...>{u.name} ({u.role})</option>` to `<option ...>{`${u.name} (${u.role})`}</option>` to eliminate the dev-mode hydration warning (same fix pattern as StokOpname.jsx:55).
(Optional) Disable Riwayat Transaksi [data-testid="export-excel-button"] while `loading` is true to prevent the one-off first-click race (reproduced once, retried OK).
(Optional) Implement DELETE /api/payroll/archive/{month} and expose a trash button in the Arsip Slip Gaji cards for admins to clean up old archives.
(Carryover from iter_17) Split server.py (>1800 lines) into routers; add non-fatal startup objstore 'Storage init failed' guard log; make /api/settings/logo return 200+null when unset.
critical_code_review_comments: exporter.js correctly uses jsPDF.save and XLSX.writeFile for every export, so Playwright's expect_download reliably observes the download event in headless chromium (23/23 downloads succeeded in this run).

All export buttons share the testids export-pdf-button/export-excel-button per page — safe because only one such button pair is rendered per page view, but prefer page-scoped ids (e.g. riwayat-export-pdf) if future pages ever stack multiple export groups.

RekapGaji archive flow is correct: POST /payroll/archive snapshots all employees for the month; archive cards link back by setMonth and re-render payroll-row-* with override values so Cetak Slip reprints identical PDF.

No cross-page console errors other than the known VE-wrapper <span>-in-<option> hydration warnings (StokOpname was reported fixed in iter17 but is still present as text-template; Kehadiran has the same).

rca of the issue: Riwayat Excel one-off failure RCA: exportExcel builds `rows` from component state that is populated by an async GET /transactions. On a fresh navigation into /riwayat the first user click can fire while `rows` is still an empty array but after the Excel button has rendered; XLSX.writeFile is called with [] and may short-circuit without triggering the download event in headless chromium. Second click (after state settled) always worked. Mitigation: disable export buttons until data has loaded (`disabled={loading}`). Kehadiran option hydration warning RCA: VE instrumentation wraps the first dynamic expression inside <option> with a <span style={{display:'contents'}}>, which React rejects for <option> children. Fix by joining to a single string literal.
